scope: Current final4 build_src read only; no edits, Studio, upload, Git or Blender run. Final4 export/placement packet had not yet been produced at review time.

pipeline.grouping: modelGroup cache makes each contract prop a Model, modelParent reparents breaker children under the cabinet; L4PIs preserves collider/light hosting after grouping in the phased importer.
pipeline.moving_parts: partName passes through export and compact placement fields into roundPart. Six Handle, one Lever, one Door and one Screen independently exported in the existing marker smoke; hinged parts are single-material and each has one chunk.
pipeline.pivot: Local 12-number pivot passes unmodified to packet; roundPart scales its translation and preserves rotation in BasePart.PivotOffset. Author uses local X for switches/lever and local Y for glass door; south-cabinet reversal uses Y180 basis.
pipeline.tags_attributes: modelTags/attrs reach Model; partAttrs reach MeshPart; Marker collider tag/attribute/name fields survive export and importer. Markers remain invisible/noncolliding/nonquerying.
pipeline.zones: Chunk zone field reaches L4Zone on pooled MeshParts; light zone field reaches holder L4Zone. Emissive world triangles are pooled by material,tags,zone with room-restricted zone lookup. Stars are explicitly global. Instanced Neon uses placement zone.
pipeline.transforms: Helpers SHIFT=(6000,0,0), ORIGIN=(29000,0,0), consistent with nav world-coordinate module.
pipeline.packet_check: final4/build_src/make_place.py --selftest PASS; covers grouped prop, marker attributes, pivot and both light/chunk zone fields.
pipeline.remaining_final_artifact_check: Verify final exported legacyLights is empty, or add a zone to any retained legacy holder: cloneLight intentionally lacks zone plumbing. Existing smoke legacyLights is empty. Final export should independently confirm 260-or-fewer actual lights and all zone IDs.

templates.usher: HumanoidRootPart PrimaryPart anchored only; all bone/anchor/torch MeshParts unanchored, noncolliding, nonquerying, nontouching, Massless. UsherHeight=7.6. All24 native Motor names and Part1 bone references present.
templates.torch: Torch welded to RightHand and Lens welded to Torch; Lens has red disabled TicketBeam SpotLight with Front face along torch.
templates.paper: Separate flat Paper primary MeshPart; SurfaceGui NoteText with Text label on Top; paper top aligned to NoteSpot by compensated primary pivot.
templates.joint_axes: Each joint rest frame aligned to actor/root Y180: actor Y up and local -Z forward. NegativeX spine lean points toward actor forward and +Y neck is yaw. Source rotations and Hips bob conjugated.
templates.runtime_scope: No CreateMeshPartAsync import, live Motor simulation, asset permission or publication check claimed.
